messages.content: You look at one picture with no other context and describe exactly what is drawn, like a careful field naturalist. Do not guess what was intended; describe only what is visible. description: a free paragraph describing the whole creature first. parts: every body part you see, one entry each (head, horns, ears, mane, legs, feet, tail, wings, gills, tentacles, shell, plates, scales, feathers, markings), with what it looks like and where it is. attached_objects: anything that looks attached to or sitting on the body rather than part of it, such as an object, an armor piece or a whole small animal; empty if none. animals: every real animal whose features you can see, as everyday English common names, at most four; include any animal that only one part resembles. Then count, looking carefully: separate_bodies: separate animal bodies or body-shaped objects in the picture, including any whole animal or animal-shaped object attached to or sitting on the main creature. heads: heads of any kind. walking_legs: legs the creature stands or walks on, including hidden ones you can infer. wings: wings of any kind. extra_limb_pieces: jointed leg-like, claw-like or tentacle-like pieces other than the walking legs and the tail.

message.content: {"animals": ["bear", "rhinoceros beetle"], "attached_objects": [], "description": "A large four-legged mammal with thick shaggy brown fur stands in side view facing right, with a bear-like head, body, legs and paws. Its back from behind the shoulders to the rump is covered by a dark glossy reddish-brown segmented dome-like shell with a larger smooth shield over the shoulders, and a row of oval holes runs in the fur along the flank just below the shell edge. A single long glossy black curved horn with tooth-like projections on its inner edge rises from the center of the forehead and curves up and back.", "extra_limb_pieces": 0, "heads": 1, "parts": [{"looks_like": "furry brown bear head with long snout", "part": "head", "where": "at front of body"}, {"looks_like": "long glossy black curved beetle horn with pointed teeth on inner edge", "part": "horn", "where": "on top of forehead between the eyes and ears, curving upward and backward"}, {"looks_like": "small rounded furry brown bear ears", "part": "ears", "where": "on top of head on either side of horn base"}, {"looks_like": "small dark brown bear eyes", "part": "eyes", "where": "on sides of head above snout"}, {"looks_like": "large black bear nose", "part": "nose", "where": "at tip of snout"}, {"looks_like": "closed bear mouth with light lip line", "part": "mouth", "where": "below nose at front of snout"}, {"looks_like": "thick shaggy brown bear legs", "part": "legs", "where": "under body, two in front and two in rear"}, {"looks_like": "broad furry bear paws with long light claws", "part": "feet", "where": "at ends of legs on the ground"}, {"looks_like": "small short furry brown bear tail", "part": "tail", "where": "at rear of body below shell"}, {"looks_like": "dark reddish-brown glossy segmented beetle carapace with transverse bands and a larger shoulder shield", "part": "shell", "where": "covering entire back from behind neck to rump"}, {"looks_like": "row of seven oval dark holes with light rims", "part": "markings", "where": "along upper flank in fur just below lower edge of shell"}, {"looks_like": "thick long shaggy brown fur", "part": "fur", "where": "covering head, neck, body, legs and tail except shell and horn"}], "separate_bodies": 1, "walking_legs": 4, "wings": 0}
